arguments.command:
python3 -c "
# Data (in thousands)
fy2010 = 200209720
fy2015 = 269716999
fy2024_actual = 384447300

# Calculate CAGR from FY 2010 to FY 2015
n_years = 5
cagr = (fy2015 / fy2010) ** (1/n_years) - 1
print(f'CAGR: {cagr}')
print(f'CAGR percentage: {cagr * 100:.6f}%')

# Project FY 2024 using FY 2015 as base year
projection_years = 9
fy2024_projected = fy2015 * (1 + cagr) ** projection_years
print(f'Projected FY 2024: {fy2024_projected}')

# Calculate percentage difference
pct_diff = (fy2024_projected - fy2024_actual) / fy2024_actual * 100
print(f'Percentage difference: {pct_diff:.6f}%')
print(f'Rounded to hundredths: {round(pct_diff, 2)}%')
"
